name: pairwave-monorepo
description: A live, end-to-end-encrypted bridge between two people's Claude Code sessions.

scripts.build: npm -w @pairwave/protocol run build && npm -w @pairwave/relay run build && npm -w @pairwave/companion run build && npm -w pairwave run build
scripts.test: npm -w @pairwave/protocol test && npm -w @pairwave/relay test && npm -w @pairwave/companion test && npm -w pairwave test
